subject: german
title: Numbers 1 to 20
welcome_lead: Counting in German from one to twenty.
final_note: Numbers are the building blocks of dates and prices.

walkthroughs.body_html: Eins, zwei, drei, vier, funf, sechs, sieben, acht, neun, zehn. Practise saying them out loud till they roll off the tongue.
Elf (11), zwolf (12), dreizehn (13), vierzehn (14), funfzehn (15), sechzehn (16). From 13, add -zehn (ten).
Siebzehn (17), achtzehn (18), neunzehn (19), zwanzig (20). Most teens just stack the digit + zehn.
